description: This is a FastAPI application implementing a promotion management and validation service. It defines data models using Pydantic, maintains in-memory promotional data, and exposes endpoints for validating promotion codes and health checking.

classes.name: PromotionValidationRequest
classes.description: Request to validate a promotion for a given order.

classes.name: PromotionValidationResult
classes.description: Validation result and computed discount for the provided promotion code.

methods.name: bool _in_window(now: datetime, start: Optional[datetime], end: Optional[datetime])
methods.description: Return True if now is within [start, end] considering optional bounds.

methods.name: validate_promotion( payload: PromotionValidationRequest = Body( ..., description="Promotion validation request" ), )
methods.description: Endpoint to validate a promotion code for an order, returning validation details.

methods.name: health()
methods.description: Health check endpoint to confirm the service is running.
